_about: Public-domain Offspring Blackall (1655-1716), Bishop of Exeter, for the Word Hoard: his Practical Discourses upon our Saviour's Sermon on the Mount (London 1717-1718, eight volumes), Practical Discourses on the Lord's Prayer (1717) and his Works (1723, two folio volumes), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 45 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
